staff_accounts_scope_check.name: staff_accounts_scope_check
staff_accounts_scope_check.value:
("staff_accounts"."role" = 'super_admin' and "staff_accounts"."school_id" is null and "staff_accounts"."subject_id" is null)
        or ("staff_accounts"."role" = 'school_admin' and "staff_accounts"."school_id" is not null and "staff_accounts"."subject_id" is null)
        or ("staff_accounts"."role" = 'teacher' and "staff_accounts"."school_id" is not null and "staff_accounts"."subject_id" is not null)

exam_classes_dispatch_check.name: exam_classes_dispatch_check
exam_classes_dispatch_check.value:
"exam_classes"."status" = 'draft' or (
        "exam_classes"."dispatched_at" is not null
        and "exam_classes"."max_attempts_snap" is not null
        and "exam_classes"."warn_limit_snap" is not null
        and "exam_classes"."interrupt_secs_snap" is not null
        and ("exam_classes"."status" <> 'closed' or "exam_classes"."closed_at" is not null)
      )

attempts_in_progress_times_check.name: attempts_in_progress_times_check
attempts_in_progress_times_check.value: "attempts"."status" <> 'in_progress' or ("attempts"."started_at" is not null and "attempts"."ends_at" is not null)
